description: This file contains the implementation of the AwsClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It defines methods for client configuration, middleware management, endpoint resolution, credential handling, and other core functionalities for interacting with AWS services.

classes.name: AwsClient
classes.description: The AwsClient class provides a comprehensive implementation for an AWS service client, including configuration, middleware setup, endpoint resolution, and request handling.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list used to process requests.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the client's configuration options, or a specific option if provided.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns the credentials used by the client.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns a command object for a specified operation.

methods.name: getEndpointProvider
methods.description: Returns the endpoint provider used by the client.

methods.name: getClientContextParams
methods.description: Provides key-value pairs used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: getClientBuiltIns
methods.description: Returns built-in keys and values used for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Applies documentation-specific filters to the service API model.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Deprecated method for instantiating the client; recommended to instantiate directly.
